items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: Really well. He’s another Ruby Braff. We were traveling in the bus in the Midwest.

ctx.x: The guys that I’ve studied, they do. Like Coltrane for example, his thirst for knowledge was amazing you know. So most of the — as far as I can tell the jazz musicians that I’ve come in contact with are extremely brilliant, they are really brilliant people. They are brilliant worldly people.
Yes. I wonder if you knew Kenny Davern? © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
Really well. He’s another Ruby Braff.
